en: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF USD (Dist)

legal_form: UCITS ETF, share class USD Distributing of iShares plc, Ireland, paid quarterly; 'Product Structure: Physical', 'Methodology: Replicated'; launch 15-Mar-2002; benchmark 'S&P 500 Index'. The factsheet has no Tel Aviv line and BlackRock's Israel brochure has no row for it.

source.title: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF USD (Dist), factsheet, data at 05-Oct-2026, p. 1: 'Total Expense Ratio : 0.07%' (library 42f663b2cc0e8cc1)

fixed_management.notes: Total expense ratio of the share class as the factsheet prints it (marketing material for UK investors; performance and net assets at 30-Sep-2026, all other data at 05-Oct-2026). The prospectus and key information document were not opened.

source.title: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF USD (Dist) U.S. Dollar (Distributing), IUSA, factsheet 'October 2026', iShares plc, p. 2 'Calendar year performance'

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The factsheet 'October 2026' (marketing material; performance as at 31-Oct-2026) prints the fund's return and its benchmark's for each calendar year 2016 to 2025 on p. 2; they are in tracking_record. Fund basis: 'Performance is shown on a Net Asset Value (NAV) basis, with gross income reinvested where applicable', in US dollars. Benchmark as the document names it: 'S&P 500 Index'. The document does not say whether the S&P 500 figures are net or gross of withholding tax on dividends. The difference is not computed here (data-update rule).

source.title: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF USD (Dist), product page: '12 Month Trailing Dividend Distribution Yield as of 29/Oct/2026 0.86%' (library a1a8783f6c7463ec)

yield.notes: As the manager's page prints it. Its own definition: income distributions over the past twelve months divided by the most recent net asset value. The page's distribution table agrees: 0.1646, 0.1654, 0.1679 and 0.1598 USD (ex-dates 17 Sep 2026, 18 Jun 2026, 19 Mar 2026, 11 Dec 2025), 0.6577 USD together. The factsheet (library 42f663b2cc0e8cc1, data at 05-Oct-2026) prints '12m Trailing Yield : 0.63%' without saying how it is computed; that does not fit those four payments at a net asset value near 76 USD, so the page's figure is the one used. Payments a year: 'Distribution Frequency Quarterly' on the same page.

source.title: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF USD (Dist), IUSA, product page: 'NAV as of 09/Nov/2026', USD 75.20

share_price.notes: F-109: the issuer's net asset value per share, the price a whole unit is bought at in the run (grown there like the fund). A market price differs slightly from the NAV and was not collected.
